zh: 卡塔尔大学（Qatar University）成立于1973年，是卡塔尔国唯一的公立大学，也是该国高等教育的旗舰机构。学校位于卡塔尔首都多哈，最初是一所综合性大学，后来发展成为一所多学科的研究型大学。卡塔尔大学在工程、医学、商业、法律、人文科学等领域提供本科和研究生教育，近年来在科研实力和国际排名方面取得了显著提升。
en: Qatar University was founded in 1973 and is Qatar's only public university and the flagship institution of higher education in the country. Located in Doha

address.zh: the university initially started as a comprehensive institution and later developed into a multidisciplinary research university. Qatar University offers undergraduate and graduate education in engineering
